title: Los Alamos insider: their propulsion systems are grown
summary: Mario Woods tells of Los Alamos insider: their propulsion systems are grown, about unspecified at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, I had one guy just say, "Well, I can Their propulsion systems are not built. They're grown."

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by non-human beings, says a man connected to Los Alamos, the US government weapons lab in New Mexico, told him something striking. According to that man, the propulsion systems of these non-human craft are not built, they are grown. If true, it would mean the craft are something closer to living things than machines.
